visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of creamy yellow scrambled eggs with pink shrimp and green onion bits scooped onto a silver spoon. The background features other white ceramic plates with various cooked foods on a dark wooden table. (2) Cut to a shot of a professional kitchen wok where a chef's hand uses a ladle to stir a mixture of raw eggs, orange shrimp, and green onions. High-pressure gas flames are visible beneath the wok. (3) The chef tosses the eggs in the wok, creating a large burst of orange flame. The environment is a clean, stainless steel commercial kitchen. (4) The camera returns to a spoon shot, placing the eggs over steamed white rice. Another bowl is shown containing fried meat with a glossy brown glaze served over rice. (5) A plate of Thai-style shrimp stir-fried with green beans, red bell peppers, and yellow bell peppers is presented. The steam rises from the hot dish. (6) In the wok, the chef stirs shrimp in a dark red, thick sauce with various vegetables. The camera is steady and focuses on the movement of the ladle and the food. (7) A single shrimp, coated in a translucent red sauce, is held up with black chopsticks for a detailed view. (8) A fast-paced montage shows several dishes being sampled: Kung Pao chicken with peanuts and dried chilies, stir-fried beef slices with colored peppers, thin slices of pork with green onions, sweet and sour pork, and stir-fried zucchini with mushrooms. (9) A close-up of a spoon lifting pieces of chicken and pineapple from a clear, warm bitter melon chicken soup. (10) Wide shot of the restaurant interior featuring high-backed wooden chairs with deer patterns and chandeliers. The final shot is a dark exterior showing a bright sign with Chinese characters.
